errors.text_span: starting at approximately 97.8% at 1e7 TFLOPS and remaining steady at approximately 99.8% from 2e7 TFLOPS onwards
errors.evidence: The 'Vanilla' line is constant at 100% for the entire x-axis range, not starting at 97.8% and leveling off at 99.8%.
The line for 'SepLLM (n=64)' uses plus sign markers, not cross markers. The line for 'SepLLM (n=128)' uses cross markers.
The line representing 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' uses diamond markers. The 'Vanilla' line uses triangle markers.
The final value for the 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' line at 9e8 TFLOPS is approximately 99.8%, not 99.3%.
The 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' line starts exactly at 94.0%, not 94.3%.
The value for 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' at 2e7 TFLOPS is approximately 95.2%, not 98.5%. The value of ~98.6% is reached at 2e8 TFLOPS.

errors.text_span: varying between approximately 98.2% and 98.7% for the remainder of the x-axis values
errors.evidence: The fluctuation range for the 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' line is incorrect. The line reaches a peak of approximately 99.1% at 4e8 TFLOPS and a low of approximately 98.1% at 5e8 TFLOPS, which is outside the stated range.
